Goes with the G2 change: in Ironheart she leaves the Masters of the Mystic Arts for her own shop, Stanton's Sweets, Reads & More (episode 4), so a 'left' meaning no group afterwards does not hold.

Ironheart episode 4 ('Bad Magic'): Zelma works the front counter of her family's candy and magic shop ('Welcome to Stanton's. We got sweets. We got reads. All your wishes guaranteed.'), and in episode 6 Parker Robbins comes to her there for magic. It is her workplace through the series.

Ironheart episode 1 (flashbacks): Gary owns and works in his own repair shop, Gary's Auto Repair, where he and Riri rebuild cars and where he is killed in the drive-by shooting. Ronnie and Riri call it 'Gary's' and 'the garage' on screen. The dataset counts a person's own business as a group (Luke's Bar, Skully's Pawn Shop, Kale Kare).

Deadpool & Wolverine: the Resistance's last strike on Cassandra ends with only Logan and Wade going through her portal to Earth-10005. The group is finished (Marvel Database: Resistance status 'Defunct', Logan 'formerly' Resistance), and Logan stays on Wade's world. Wade (A:fox-deadpool) and Laura (A:fox-x-23) already go from The Resistance to Independent in this title with a left entry; Logan's record has no such move. Add 'Deadpool & Wolverine' to left.

Goes with the groups change above: the Resistance ends in Deadpool & Wolverine when Logan and Wade leave the Void through Cassandra's portal, and Logan belongs to no group afterwards (he stays with Wade's friends on Earth-10005). Same left entry as Wade and Laura already have for this title.

Deadpool & Wolverine: Dogpool (Mary Puppins) is a Deadpool variant pruned by the TVA to the Void, not a native of the main MCU (Earth-199999). Marvel Database files her as Mary Puppins (Earth-TRN872), its designation for those pruned to the Void whose home reality is unknown (now displaced to Earth-10005). Nicepool (A:nicepool) is filed the same way there.
